tips_en: Read SLA first: it offers the broadest practical advance, injecting transferable 3D spatial reasoning into general-purpose robotic manipulation while preserving the original inference architecture and requiring no depth sensor at deployment. SLA and GSNorm are complementary geometry-focused papers—the former distills spatial knowledge from a 3D teacher, while the latter normalizes scale ambiguity in feed-forward Gaussian reconstruction. Harness-S also shares a useful training principle: auxiliary scaffolding is used only during learning and then internalized, as sibling harnesses rescue failed rollouts while SLA’s spatial modules are discarded after training.
tips_zh: 建议优先阅读 SLA：它在不改变推理架构、部署时也无需深度传感器的前提下，将可迁移的三维空间理解引入通用机器人操作，工程影响最全面。SLA 与 GSNorm 都关注几何先验和尺度一致性，前者从三维教师中蒸馏空间知识，后者则通过高斯间距归一化缓解重建中的尺度歧义。Harness-S 在方法理念上也与 SLA 相通：辅助结构仅用于训练并最终被内化——兄弟 harness 补救失败 rollout，而 SLA 的空间模块在训练后被移除。
